task: This folder is a small Node.js Express API (index.js, package.json, test/). Add a GET /todos/:id endpoint that returns the todo with that id as JSON, or 404 with {"error":"not found"} when there is none, and a POST /todos endpoint that validates a non-empty string `title` (400 otherwise) and returns 201 with the created todo. Add tests for both endpoints (node:test + supertest are already in package.json) and make `npm test` pass. Commit nothing yourself.

accept.name: tests were added
accept.cmd: c() { awk -F: '{s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'; }; before=$(git grep -cE '\b(it|test)\(' "$BASE" -- ':(glob)**/*test*' ':(exclude)__acceptance__' | c); after=$(git grep --untracked -cE '\b(it|test)\(' -- ':(glob)**/*test*' ':(exclude)__acceptance__' | c); echo "test cases: $before -> $after"; [ "$after" -gt "$before" ]

rubric: Check id parsing (Number/parseInt of the param, no string-vs-number comparison bug, sensible handling of non-numeric ids), that new ids cannot collide with existing ones after deletes or restarts of the in-memory list, and that validation rejects non-strings and empty titles before mutating state. Whitespace-only titles are a judgment call; trimming is a plus. The created todo should have a consistent shape with the seed todos (id, title, done:false). Tests should cover the 404 body and each 400 case, and must not depend on test order through shared state in a fragile way.
